## Enrollment Flow Diagram

This document renders the enrollment flow diagram from the derived Stata dataset produced by `VR_ICU.do`.

By default, it reads `outputs/stata/db_for_consort.dta` and writes rendered PNG files to `outputs/figures/`. Set `VR_ICU_CONSORT_DTA` or `VR_ICU_FIGURE_DIR` in the environment to override those paths.

```{r}
#| echo: false
library(consort)
library(dplyr)
library(haven)
library(rsvg)
library(DiagrammeRsvg)
library(magick)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
consort_data_path <- Sys.getenv("VR_ICU_CONSORT_DTA", "outputs/stata/db_for_consort.dta")
figure_dir <- Sys.getenv("VR_ICU_FIGURE_DIR", "outputs/figures")

if (!file.exists(consort_data_path)) {
  stop(
    "Derived CONSORT dataset not found at: ", consort_data_path,
    "\nRun `stata-mp -b do VR_ICU.do` first, or set VR_ICU_CONSORT_DTA."
  )
}

dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
consort_png <- file.path(figure_dir, "consort.png")
consort_dpi300_png <- file.path(figure_dir, "consort_dpi300.png")

vr_paper_data <- read_dta(consort_data_path)

vr_paper_data <- vr_paper_data %>%
  mutate(
    didnt_finish = na_if(didnt_finish, ""),
    reason_declined = na_if(reason_declined, ""),
    no_survey = NA_character_,
    no_survey = if_else(
      date == "2024-01-19",
      "Time-sensitive patient care need",
      no_survey
    )
  )

p_cons <- consort_plot(
  vr_paper_data,
  order = list(
    id = "Patients approached",
    reason_declined = "Declined to participate",
    id = "Agreed to participate",
    didnt_finish = "Did not start VR",
    patient_id = "Completed VR experience",
    no_survey = "Did not finish survey",
    patient_id = "Completed all study assessments"
  ),
  side_box = c("reason_declined", "didnt_finish", "no_survey"),
  cex = 1.3,
  text_width = 40
)

plot(p_cons, grViz = TRUE) |>
  DiagrammeRsvg::export_svg() |>
  charToRaw() |>
  rsvg::rsvg_png(file = consort_png, width = 900, height = 1200)

image <- image_read(consort_png)
image_write(image, path = consort_dpi300_png, density = 300)
```
